instruction: Candid action medium photograph from a high angle in an indoor judo dojo with yellow mats. The young man with short dark hair (R2) in a white judo gi is seen from behind, pinning the woman with curly brown hair in a bun (R1) in a blue judo gi to the mat. The woman lies on her back, looking up at him. The scene is illuminated by bright, diffuse indoor lighting, highlighting the warm yellow tones of the mat.
